profile.name: Devraj Satish Sawant
profile.intro: I’m based in Mumbai. I build web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript—from the screens people use to the APIs and data behind them.

experience.story: I work on the booking and session-management flows that connect students with experts, including payments, messaging, and video sessions.
highlights: Built the student-to-expert booking and session-management experience.
Connected payment flows to secure, straightforward bookings.
Brought people together with real-time messaging, notifications, and BigBlueButton video sessions.
Created reusable UI and integrated REST APIs to keep product features consistent as they grow.

experience.story: At Quvor, I worked on TribeCrafter’s search, discussions, notifications, and authentication. I also handled a Mantine upgrade and refactored legacy UI.
highlights: Built universal search, threaded newsfeed discussions, notifications, and authentication for TribeCrafter.
Added instant notification toasts over WebSockets to make conversations feel alive.
Moved Mantine from v7 to v8, working through breaking changes and dependency conflicts to restore reliable production builds.
Refactored legacy UI and introduced code splitting for a more maintainable, faster-loading app.

experience.story: My first frontend role involved two production eCommerce platforms and GNEXT, a promoter-management application. I built reusable components and connected them to product APIs.
highlights: Built reusable Next.js and TypeScript components and core features for two production eCommerce platforms.
Created GNEXT, a promoter-management application for inventory, CRUD workflows, attendance, and analytics dashboards.
Learned to work with real product constraints, evolving APIs, and the responsibility of shipping production code.

projects.name: InveeSync
projects.description: An email-to-purchase-order workflow with a workspace for reviewing extracted order data.
projects.story: I built a four-panel workspace to compare incoming orders with source documents, flag validation errors, and correct fields before conversion.
details: Built REST APIs and relational data models for complex, multi-level sales orders.
Designed field-level mappings, validation workflows, and exception handling to make order conversion safer and easier to review.

projects.name: PEN School
projects.description: A responsive school website with a custom admin panel for blogs and events.
projects.story: I built the public website and the content-management interface so school staff could publish updates without editing code.
details: Designed and built a modern, responsive site focused on visual clarity and performance.
Created a custom admin panel for updating blogs and events without changing code.
